quests.title: Fertilizer... Salesperson?

dialogue.t: *sigh* I do hope I succeed this time...
Thank you, Traveler, thank you...
I was halfway through making the fertilizer when those monsters came charging up out of nowhere...
That's so strange... But it's good that you showed up when you did.

dialogue.sit: It might be because of that pile of fertilizer, you know...

dialogue.t: R—Really? I've heard that this smell is a sign that you might have succeeded.
Well, in any case, come over here and have a look at the fertilizer. I'll explain as I open it up...
Hold it!
Eh? Mr. Gorou? I wasn't aware that you'd be passing this way today.
I... Uh, never mind that first.
Is this pile of... stuff your doing?
Hahaha, yes. This fertilizer was the work of our hands.
Mr. Gorou, did you come here to check on the fertilizer as well?
Hehe, in that case, let's...
Wait! Hold on a moment. I'm not here for that. Wait, actually, I am... But...
Gorou's face is twisting up something awful...

dialogue.sit: Let's... adjourn to someplace a little further away...

dialogue.t: Alright, let's do that.
So, Mr. Gorou, why are you here?
Lately, a lot of residents have been complaining of a terrifying stench nearby...
So for safety, I came to investigate, and wound up following the smell all the way here.
That's how I found you.
Iwata, I've heard that you've been researching fertilizer, but the way that you're going about it is...
Basically. Either way, Iwata, could you please dispose of that fertilizer? We'll try to help you find some other way.
Sir! General Gorou!
I'm here. What's happened?
General, we caught a suspicious person out in the outskirts.
She was acting very furtively, calling herself a... fertilizer salesperson, or somesuch.
I thought that was awful strange, so I had this person detained. I thought that you might wish to see to her questioning.
Fertilizer this, fertilizer that... What is it with me and fertilizer today...
I've got it. I'll be with you shortly. Head back first and help to maintain order.
Iwata, please deal with the matter of the fertilizer. We'll discuss this further later.
Traveler, why don't you come with me?

dialogue.sit: Doesn't seem like there's anything else to do.

dialogue.t: Someone selling fertilizer? Paimon can't help feel like that's familiar somehow... Nothing's coming to mind, though...
Ah well, whatever. Let's just go over there and see what's up!
*sigh* Fertilizers are much trickier than I thought...
Stay right there and don't move!
I—I'm not moving! You asked me to explain, and I explained that I'm really a researcher from the Akademiya!
Didn't you say that you're advertising fertilizer?
I... Can't a researcher from the Akademiya also advertise for fertilizers? Just... Just listen to me for a moment, will you...
Is this the person?
Yes, sir.
When we caught her, she was sneaking around the place and wouldn't stop writing certain things down.
General, I'm positive that she's a Shogunate spy!
I'm not! And I wasn't! I already told you, I'm a researcher! I was just collecting material for my thesis!
Cut the crap! Do you seriously expect us to believe that you'd walk into a battlefield over a thesis? You're definitely playing at something else!
...What could I really dare to play at other than my thesis anyway...
Traveler! Oh, this is wonderful! Please tell them I'm not a bad person! I'm just here to write my thesis!
You know her?
Does "graduating" really drive researchers from Sumeru this far up the wall...
But given what you've said, you're only acquaintances at best.
And as for her status as a "researcher from Sumeru," that's something you only heard from her, isn't it?
Hmm... I'm afraid that none of the evidence here is conclusive.
But if she's got your guarantee, I'd wager that she isn't a bad person...
General, if I may make a suggestion?
Do you remember Kaushik? That researcher who's been studying our island's culture and history?
He's been here all this while, and his credentials are quite solid... Why don't we ask him to tell if this... fertilizer saleswoman is actually a researcher or not?
That actually sounds like a decent plan. Traveler, could we trouble you to bring Kaushik here?
Just in case of any incidents, I'll stay here and guard this... fertilizer saleswoman.
It's up to you then. Come back as quickly as possible.
I... I'm just here to write a thesis. How in the world did I end up locked up again...
Bring Kaushik back with you. The sooner the better...
I don't get how this person is supposed to look like a researcher.
What a suspicious character.
The meaning of this totem... Hmm? Traveler? Did you have some business with me?
Alrani's here? On Watatsumi Island? That's... odd. What's that girl doing here? Shouldn't she be in Liyue?

dialogue.sit: She was arrested by some soldiers...

dialogue.t: What? *sigh* Of course. Coming to Watatsumi Island under the present circumstances... Of course they would suspect her.
Never mind that for now. Let's head over and help that reckless girl out...

dialogue.section: Kaushik, Alrani, Gorou, Hiroyuki, Ookubo Daisuke

dialogue.t: Alrani! It really is you! B—But why are you here in Inazuma? Weren't you supposed to be in Liyue?
This... Oh, this is going to be long story, isn't it...
Mr. Kaushik, you know Alrani?
Oh, you... you're General Gorou, aren't you?
You surmise correctly. Alrani and I are both researchers from the Akademiya.
After that, we left the Akademiya to conduct fieldwork for our own areas of research. I didn't think that I'd meet her here...
But... Um, can you researchers just freely leave the Akademiya?
I wouldn't call it "leaving freely." Alrani and I are both Driyosh.
To us, wandering and learning are part of our research process, and as such, we are permitted to leave the Akademiya.
General Gorou, I can guarantee that Alrani is telling the truth...
Alright, then there's no problem.
Phew... I'm saved... Thank you so much...
Hiroyuki, Ookubo, this matter is settled. Go attend to your own duties.
Yes, sir.
Yes, sir.
I'm sorry, Miss Alrani. We mistook you for someone suspicious.
That said, while we have cleared your name, your barging into Watatsumi Island like this has made no shortage of trouble for us.
Eh? Are... Are you going to fine me? I—I don't have very much Mora on me...
Well, since you did claim to be a fertilizer salesperson earlier, and you're a researcher to boot...
Well, there is something you can do for us. We have a man named Iwata living here who's researching fertilizer. Miss Alrani, please lend him a hand.
If you can help him produce some fertilizer that isn't also a public disturbance, then you're free to do research here, just like Mr. Kaushik.
F—Fertilizer? Wait, I... I'm just...
Alrani, this is a good opportunity to collect research material. Since you're here in Inazuma, that must mean that your thesis is still...
Uh... Ugh...
You know what the standards for graduation are at the Akademiya. If you can't graduate several years in a row...
I—I'll do it! I'll do it, alright?
I—I've learned about the fertilizer at Mr. Vahid's... I'll get this done in one go, just you all watch!
Well, then we'll call this a day for now. Miss Alrani, the fertilizer matter is in your hands. I've got some other matters to handle, so if you'll excuse me...
Ah, yes. Please remind Iwata to, uh, move his fertilizer a bit further away.
Alright, I'll continue with my research now. If you have any questions, Alrani, just feel free to ask me.
Traveler, you're back. I've disposed of that pile of fertilizer.
*sigh* I suppose I'll have to find another place to conduct my experiments...
Hmm? This person is...
Hello, I'm Alrani...
Well, either way... The general they called Gorou requested that I assist you with your fertilizer research.
It's a pleasure to be working with you from now on.
Is that so... That's great! If we succeed, then we'll be able to plant more crops here on Watatsumi Island!

dialogue.sit: Do remember to pile the fertilizer further away.

dialogue.t: Eh? Oh! Oh, I get it.
Yes, the pleasure is all mine, Miss Alrani!
Yeah, I'll do my best.
I'll do my best. This is for my thesis...

quests.description: Iwata of Watatsumi Island appears to be having some troubles…
